scope: All six meta-type design findings; not activation of seven Product enhancements

items.resolution: Declared PreparationFacts and exact simple Policy labels compile in the complete selection.
Rules, Calculations, Policies, Mappings and Operations have distinct roles; ReadProjection alone is the stored keyed Query.
One canonical existing journal is explicit; the candidate Entity is a reconstructible immutable cache. NoteCommand carries command identity, revision and source cut and is inert.

Bounded logical Interfaces, all 11 typed Entries, selected native principal ABI and distinct observation/author/read permissions are explicit. Source custody and reported-attribution limits are specified.
No Event is declared or selected. Handoff and acknowledgement use zero-effect typed values; notifications need a future explicit contract.
Large content is referenced by byte-bound document manifests, limits are unchanged, and maximum-length/escaped-reference and large-original-size tests pass.
